Repeat Structure Test
Count: 32  Wall: 4  Level: Absolute Beginner

32 Count Intro

SIDE TOGETHERS
1-2 Step right foot side right, step left foot together
3-6 Repeat 1-2 two more times
7-8 Step right foot side right, touch left foot together

MIRROR SIDE
1-8 Repeat 1-8 with left foot

STOMP AND HOLD
1 – 2 Stomp right forward, hold
3 - 4 Stomp left forward, hold
5-8 Repeat above

MARCH IT OUT
1-8 March in place for 8 counts, gradually turning 1/4 turn to the left

REPEAT

OPTION 1:
1-4 Touch right heel forward 4 times
